entities.summary: Zvi Hauser is an Israeli lawyer and public figure who served as the 17th cabinet secretary. Hauser served as a member of the Knesset between 2019 and 2022. During this term he held a number of positions including: deputy speaker of the Knesset, chairman of the Foreign Affairs and Defense Committee and head of the Israel-Japan Parliamentary Friendship Association.
